name: finddata-coding-crew
description: The v2 five-role coding crew (planner, explorer, implementer, merger, verifier) plus the three roles team-v3 adds: relay measures the model path and hands out the round's concurrency width, contractor pins the public interface to one machine-readable contract, sentry gates the merge on artifacts that actually exist. Tool grants follow the v2 roster. team-v3 narrows some of those grants and gives planner Glob, so for a pure v3 crew generate the definitions with `fd-agent-graph export --manifest roster/team-v3.yaml` rather than reusing these. Ships the agent-graph-gate skill that checks a collaboration graph's shape before dispatch.

description_i18n.zh-CN: v2 五角色编码班底（规划者、侦察、实现、合并、验收）+ team-v3 新增的三个角色：探路者量模型路径并给出本轮并发宽度、契约官把公开接口钉成一份机器可读契约、守门者在合并前验产物真在。工具授权以 v2 名册为准；v3 对其中四个角色收窄了授权、并给规划者加了 Glob，所以纯 v3 班底请用 `fd-agent-graph export --manifest roster/team-v3.yaml` 生成，别直接复用这里的定义。附带派发前检查协作图形状的 agent-graph-gate 技能。
